voice.name: Chris - Charming, Down-to-Earth
voice.why: A brisk, friendly middle-aged American voice for the market fishmonger: a seller who talks to every customer. No other NPC uses it.

greet.text: Fresh off the boats this morning. Mackerel, bass, perch. Look all you like, but touch nothing you will not buy.

about_catch.text: The boats go out before light and are back by noon. Whatever they land, I put on the ice. If you catch your own, the wholesale counter at the dock buys it.

about_prices.text: Mackerel is cheap. Bass costs more. Tuna only comes when the boats get lucky. The price is on the board, and I do not haggle.

bye.text: Mind the wet boards on your way out.

replies.catch: Where does your fish come from?
